tools.name: erp_sales_orders_list
tools.description: List sales order transactions, optionally filtered by status or customer entity (GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder)

status.description: Order status filter: pendingApproval, pendingFulfillment, billed or cancelled.

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id the order is billed to, e.g. customer_006.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_sales_order_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single sales order by its tranId-style internal identifier (GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id})

id.description: Sales order document number (tranId), e.g. SO-2026-0104.

tools.name: erp_sales_order_create
tools.description: Create a sales order for a customer; new orders start in pendingApproval (POST /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id the order is billed to, e.g. customer_002.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account, e.g. 'Summit Group Account'.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

total.description: Order total in the transaction currency (total).

tools.name: erp_sales_order_update_status
tools.description: Transition a sales order along its lifecycle: pendingApproval -> pendingFulfillment -> billed (cancel allowed before billing); invalid jumps are rejected (PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id})

id.description: Sales order document number (tranId), e.g. SO-2026-0103.

status.description: Target status: pendingFulfillment, billed or cancelled. Must be a valid next step from the order's current status.

tools.name: erp_saved_search_run
tools.description: Run a simplified transaction saved search over sales orders; keywords LIKE-match against tranId, customer name, memo and status (POST /services/rest/query/v1/suiteql)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_invoices_list
tools.description: List invoice transactions (AR), optionally filtered by status, customer entity or originating sales order (GET /services/rest/record/v1/invoice)

status.description: Invoice status filter: open, paid or voided.

created_from.description: Originating sales order tranId (createdFrom), e.g. SO-2026-0105.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_invoice_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice with totals and amount remaining (GET /services/rest/record/v1/invoice/{id})

tools.name: erp_invoice_create
tools.description: Create a standalone or order-billed invoice; new invoices open with the full amount remaining (POST /services/rest/record/v1/invoice)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id billed on the invoice, e.g. customer_006.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account.

created_from.description: Sales order tranId this invoice bills (createdFrom); omit for standalone invoices.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

subtotal.description: Sum of line amounts before tax (subtotal).

tools.name: erp_items_list
tools.description: List items in the GTM catalog (licenses, data feeds, services, appliances), optionally filtered by item type or inactive flag (GET /services/rest/record/v1/serviceItem, also inventoryItem/nonInventoryItem)

type.description: Item type filter: inventoryItem, nonInventoryItem or serviceItem.

is_inactive.description: Set 1 to list only retired items, 0 for active items (isInactive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_item_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single item record by its itemId/SKU (GET /services/rest/record/v1/serviceItem/{id})

id.description: Item id / SKU (itemId), e.g. FEED-MKT-L2 or HW-DFA-100.

tools.name: erp_item_create
tools.description: Create a new item in the catalog (POST /services/rest/record/v1/serviceItem)

display_name.description: Item display name shown on transaction lines (displayName).

type.description: Item type: inventoryItem, nonInventoryItem or serviceItem.

currency.description: Pricing currency internal id; catalog prices are usd.

income_account.description: Income account posted on sale, e.g. '4030 Services Revenue' (incomeAccount).

tools.name: erp_inventory_levels_list
tools.description: List per-location inventory balances for stocked items, optionally filtered by item or location (POST /services/rest/query/v1/suiteql - inventorybalance)

item.description: Item id / SKU filter, e.g. HW-DFA-100.

location.description: Location name filter: Newark DC, London DC or Frankfurt DC.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_inventory_adjustment_create
tools.description: Post an inventory adjustment that changes quantity on hand by adjustQtyBy for one item at one location; adjustments that would drive stock negative are rejected (POST /services/rest/record/v1/inventoryAdjustment)

item.description: Item id / SKU being adjusted, e.g. HW-DFA-200.

location.description: Adjustment location (adjLocation): Newark DC, London DC or Frankfurt DC.

adjust_qty_by.description: Signed quantity delta (adjustQtyBy); negative decreases stock.

tools.name: erp_vendor_bills_list
tools.description: List vendor bill transactions (AP), optionally filtered by payment status, approval status or vendor entity (GET /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill)

status.description: Bill payment status filter: open or paid.

approval_status.description: Approval routing status filter (approvalStatus): pendingApproval, approved or rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_vendor_bill_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single vendor bill by its tranId-style identifier (GET /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill/{id})

id.description: Vendor bill document number (tranId), e.g. BILL-3002.

tools.name: erp_vendor_bill_create
tools.description: Enter a vendor bill; new bills are open and route as pendingApproval (POST /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill)

entity.description: Vendor (entity) internal id the bill is payable to, e.g. vendor_001.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

amount.description: Bill amount in the transaction currency (userTotal).

tools.name: erp_vendor_bill_approve
tools.description: Approve a vendor bill that is pending approval (approvalStatus pendingApproval -> approved); already-approved or rejected bills are refused (PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill/{id})

id.description: Vendor bill document number (tranId), e.g. BILL-3003.

tools.name: erp_customer_payments_list
tools.description: List customer payment transactions, optionally filtered by customer entity or the invoice they were applied to (GET /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment)

applied_to.description: Invoice tranId the payment was applied against, e.g. INV-1002; unapplied payments have an empty value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_customer_payment_create
tools.description: Record a customer payment and apply it to an open invoice; reduces the invoice's amount remaining and marks it paid when it reaches zero. Overpayments, voided invoices and currency mismatches are rejected (POST /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment)

applied_to.description: Invoice tranId to apply the payment against, e.g. INV-1004.

payment.description: Payment amount to apply (payment); must not exceed the invoice's amount remaining.

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id; defaults to the invoice's customer.

trandate.description: Payment date (trandate), YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

payment_method.description: Payment method: wire, ach, check or card (default wire).

currency.description: Payment currency internal id; must match the invoice currency (defaults to it).

tools.name: erp_credit_memos_list
tools.description: List credit memo transactions, optionally filtered by status or customer entity (GET /services/rest/record/v1/creditMemo)

status.description: Credit memo status filter: open or fullyApplied.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_credit_memo_create
tools.description: Issue a credit memo to a customer, optionally referencing the invoice it credits (POST /services/rest/record/v1/creditMemo)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id receiving the credit, e.g. customer_007.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account.

created_from.description: Invoice tranId this memo credits (createdFrom); omit for standalone credits.

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

total.description: Credit total in the transaction currency (total).

tools.name: erp_currencies_list
tools.description: List currency records with ISO symbol and exchange rate to the base currency (GET /services/rest/record/v1/currency)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).

tools.name: erp_subsidiaries_list
tools.description: List subsidiaries in the corporate hierarchy, including the consolidation elimination subsidiary (GET /services/rest/record/v1/subsidiary)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
